note: One read only tools/call per MCP endpoint. Never list a tool that writes (on hs-mcp, verify_fair_price and create_ap2_fairness_attestation append to a public ledger). readOnlyHint alone is not enough: the gate marks check_conformance readOnlyHint true but it records a check, so it is not used here.

endpoints.why_safe: readOnlyHint true; workers/hs-mcp/test/tool_selection.test.mjs asserts only verify_fair_price and create_ap2_fairness_attestation are readOnlyHint false. Japanese query and no region, so the English normalization and region counters are not touched; it still adds to usage:total and usage:skill:get_price_range, which /.well-known/usage-stats.json publishes (about 24 a day from this probe).
